messages:
Sam: kicking off canary helm upgrade for chart inference-gpu-pool v2.3.0 -> v2.4.0 (canary=10%). triggered via ArgoCD, will watch logs. @Olivia FYI.

deploy-bot: ArgoCD: sync started for apps/inference-gpu-pool (rev: main@abc123) • canary=10%

Olivia: canary created the post-upgrade Job 'reconcile-gpu-nodes' but the Job pod is Pending for >2m, not starting. No image pull errors.

Maria: grabbed the pod logs from the hook pod:
```
Error from server (Forbidden): nodes "gke-eu-central-1-node-2" is forbidden: User \"system:serviceaccount:infra:helm-hook-sa\" cannot patch resource \"nodes\" in API group \"\" at the cluster scope
```

Ashish: that looks like RBAC. Did we change the helm-hook SA CRB in the last infra TF change? I remember a security PR around namespaced bindings.

Maria: yes — terraform PR #1027 replaced a clusterRoleBinding with a namespaced roleBinding for helm-hook-sa as part of the tightened privileges rollout. That removed cluster-wide node patch perms.

Sam: rough. Two questions: (1) quick way to let canary continue? (2) why didn't the canary fail earlier in CI?

Olivia: quick win would be to restore the clusterRoleBinding for helm-hook-sa. But note: even if RBAC is fixed, the Job tries to create a new node pool label which triggers the autoscaler; cloud quota in eu-central is currently exhausted so the autoscaler will fail to scale. I pulled the cloud console — GPU quota remaining: 0/200 for project-redwood-eu-central.

Maria: rollback is also blocked — helm rollback is failing with the gpupool CRD finalizer. Log from Tiller-ish output:
```
Error: release: \"inference-gpu-pool\" failed: timed out waiting for the condition
helm rollback 1 -> release hooks: post-upgrade hook \"reconcile-gpu-nodes\" failed: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = cannot delete resource \"gpupool-canary\" because it has finalizer \"gpupool.cleanup.redwood.com\"
```

Ashish: so we have a three-way: RBAC change, CRD finalizer blocking rollback, and cloud GPU quota at 0. Fix path options: (A) re-grant clusterRoleBinding to helm-hook-sa + request emergency quota bump; (B) patch the finalizer off to let rollback proceed then revert RBAC; (C) modify chart to skip node-patching hook and roll forward.

Maria: my recommended immediate unblock: 1) create emergency clusterrolebinding helm-hook-sa -> cluster-admin (temp) 2) kubectl patch gpupool gpupool-canary -p '{"metadata":{"finalizers":null}}' --type=merge 3) Argo resume/rollback. I'll open PRs to restore least-privilege CRB after.

Sam: go ahead with (1)+(2) if you're comfortable. I'll open an incident and contact cloud-quotas for emergency GPU increase. @Olivia can you take the pager to confirm quota request?

Olivia: on it — pinging cloud-quotas and CCing infra-sre. Also adding a short maintenance note: canary paused until we confirm quota. :eyes:

deploy-bot: ArgoCD: sync failed for inference-gpu-pool: post-upgrade hook job "reconcile-gpu-nodes" failed, app out of sync. See: https://argo.redwood/apps/inference-gpu-pool/logs/12345

Ashish: will follow up with a Terraform revert PR for #1027 to restore the clusterRoleBinding while we design a safer long-term solution. Also adding a card to the backlog to make hook idempotent and not require node patching during canaries.

Maria: patching finalizer now and applying temporary CRB. Will post updates in this thread when done.

Sam: thanks team. Keep messages short in the incident ticket; add the helm release and hook job IDs.
